title: Add owner check to validateApp in shared contracts
Pass team from package.json as owner in each app calling validateApp
Verify build and startup of all affected apps

summary: validateApp in libs/shared-contracts now throws when app.owner is missing or empty. Callers pass owner from package.json team: core-shell=platform, sub-route-billing=payments, sub-route-reports=insights. PR #1 (mono) merged; CI and CD succeeded on main. Assumptions: the only validateApp callers are in mono (grep found three, none in platformkit); libs/ is inlined at build time, so no version bump was needed; owner is hardcoded to match package.json rather than read at build time. Each app was built locally and the validation was checked directly in node. Note: the baseline commit has DEPLOY_ENABLED=true, so merging deployed to S3 via the real publish path.
